name: Arrow of Dusk
shortDescription: Ranged touch ray deals 2d4 nonlethal damage (x3 on critical hit).
text: A bolt of shadow springs from your hand. Succeed on a ranged touch attack to deal 2d4 nonlethal damage (x3 crit).

name: Black Candle

effects.text: Choose either light or darkness at the time of casting.

shortDescription: Functions as the spell light or darkness (choose at casting).
text: Draw on extraplanar shadow or banish existing shadows: functions like light or darkness (choose one per use).

name: Caul of Shadow
shortDescription: Grants +1 deflection bonus to AC (+1 per 6 caster levels, max +4).
text: Shifting field of semisolid shadows faintly darkens your form and grants +1 deflection bonus to AC (+1 per 6 CL, maximum +4).

name: Liquid Night

effects.text: Creates one page of glowing shadow ink (candlelight illumination in darkness; washes away in water).

shortDescription: Create glowing ink (candlelight in darkness) enough for one page.
text: Create enough ink for one page of text (not for scribing spells). Glows red/yellow like a candle in darkness until washed with water.

name: Mystic Reflections

effects.text: Detect magic out to 30 ft.

shortDescription: Functions as detect magic out to 30 ft.
text: Peer slightly into the Plane of Shadow to see distortions from magic, functioning as detect magic up to 30 feet away.

name: Shadow Hood

effects.condition: Also applies -1 penalty on Dexterity-based checks (Will negates)

shortDescription: Distracting shadows impose -1 penalty on attacks and Dex-based checks.
text: Swirling shadows manifest around the subject's head, imposing a -1 penalty on attack rolls and Dexterity-based checks.

name: Sight Obscured

effects.condition: Also applies to checks concealing actions or gestures

shortDescription: Grants +5 circumstance bonus on Hide, Sleight of Hand, and gesture concealment checks.
text: Cloak the subject's movements in shifting shadow, granting a +5 circumstance bonus on Hide, Sleight of Hand, and checks to conceal actions/gestures.

name: Umbral Hand

delivery.target: One unattended object up to 5 lb./level

effects.text: As mage hand up to 5 lb./level, including magic items (Will negates object).

shortDescription: Functions as mage hand, up to 5 lb./level and including magic items.
text: Functions like mage hand, except it manipulates objects up to 5 lb./level including magic items (Will negates for magic items); direct with free action each round.

name: Widened Eyes

effects.what: Low-light vision (stacks to 4x if already possessed)

shortDescription: Gain low-light vision (stacks to 4x if already possessed).
text: Gain low-light vision (2x human range in poor illumination); if you already have low-light vision, stacks to 4x range.

name: Steel Shadows
shortDescription: Grants +3 armor bonus and +3 shield bonus to AC without ACP or ASF.
text: Darkness coalesces into weightless shadow-armor and shadow-shield, granting +3 armor bonus and +3 shield bonus to AC with no ACP, ASF, or speed penalty (not a force effect).

name: Sight Eclipsed

effects.text: Attempt Hide checks even while being observed (as if having cover/concealment).

shortDescription: Attempt Hide checks even while being observed.
text: Cloak yourself in shadow; you can attempt Hide checks even while being observed, as if you had cover or concealment.

name: Sharp Shadows

effects.condition: Retaliatory damage to non-reach melee attackers (SR applies unless Su)

shortDescription: Creatures striking you in melee take 1d6 + 1/CL (max +15) damage.
text: Cloak yourself in spikes of darkness. Any creature striking you with body or handheld weapon (non-reach) takes 1d6 + 1/CL (max +15) nonmagical damage.

name: Carpet of Shadow

effects.text: Affected squares become difficult terrain (double movement cost).

shortDescription: Cloak ground in difficult terrain (2 squares movement cost per square).
text: The ground becomes difficult terrain, doubling movement cost for every affected 5-ft. square.

name: Black Fire
shortDescription: Shadowy black flame deals 1d6/2 CL cold damage to creatures in/entering squares.
text: Shapeable curtain of black flame on the ground deals 1d6 cold damage per 2 caster levels to creatures starting in or entering affected squares (Reflex negates).

name: Clinging Darkness

effects.text: Creatures inside or entering must make Reflex save or become immobilized (cannot move from square).

shortDescription: 20-ft. emanation immobilizes creatures on failed Reflex save.
text: Writhing shadows immobilize creatures within or entering the 20-ft. area (Reflex negates; immobilized subjects can retry Reflex as a full-round action each turn).

name: Voice of Shadow

effects.text: As command, OR necromancy option dazes undead/constructs for 1 round (Will negates).

shortDescription: Functions as command, or dazes undead/constructs for 1 round.
text: Functions like the spell command; second necromancy option dazes undead and constructs for 1 round on a failed Will save (choose one mode per casting).

name: Congress of Shadows

delivery.target: One living creature whose exact/approx location is known

effects.text: Two-way telepathic message (5 + CL words) up to 1 mile/level on same plane.

shortDescription: Deliver telepathic message (5 + 1/CL words) and receive reply.
text: Send a telepathic message of up to 5 words + 1 word/caster level within 1 mile/level; target may reply with the same number of words (cannot cross planes).

name: Flicker

effects.what: 50% miss chance when triggered in response to an attack

effects.text: Immediate action 1/round: teleport 5 ft. per 2 caster levels (arrives accurately as dimension door).

shortDescription: Immediate action teleport 5 ft./2 CL once/round (50% miss chance vs attack).
text: Once per round as an immediate action, teleport up to 5 ft. per 2 caster levels (as dimension door). If used in response to an attack, the attack has a 50% miss chance.

name: Bend Perspective

effects.text: Remote perspective within Close range; swift action toggle; move sensor 10 ft./rd at cost of 1 min duration.

shortDescription: Shift viewpoint up to 25 ft. + 5 ft./2 CL; switch as swift action.
text: View the world from another spot within 25 ft. + 5 ft./2 CL (with line of effect). Switch between views as a swift action; move sensor 10 ft./rd (reduces duration by 1 min/rd moved).

name: Piercing Sight

effects.text: See invisible and ethereal creatures/objects as see invisibility.

shortDescription: Gain see invisibility and darkvision 60 ft.
text: See invisible and ethereal creatures/objects as see invisibility, plus darkvision out to 60 feet.

name: Killing Shadows
shortDescription: 30-ft. cone deals 1d8/CL (max 10d8) damage (Will half).
text: Your eyes shoot a 30-ft. shadowy cone dealing 1d8 damage per caster level (maximum 10d8), or half on a successful Will save.

name: Dusk and Dawn

effects.text: Blankets 20-ft.-radius emanation in shadowy illumination (darkvision sees normally).

shortDescription: Adjust lighting in 20-ft. radius to shadowy illumination.
text: Make a dark area lighter or a bright area darker, blanketing the 20-ft.-radius emanation in shadowy illumination.

name: Shadow Skin
shortDescription: Immediate action grants scaling DR (5/magic up to 15/—) until next turn.
text: Cast as an immediate action to gain DR until start of your next turn: 5/magic (<=4th CL), 10/magic (5th-9th), 10/silver (10th-14th), 15/silver (15th-19th), 15/— (20th).

name: Dancing Shadows

effects.what: Concealment 20% (multiple targets) or Total Concealment 50% (single target)

shortDescription: Grant subjects concealment (20%), or total concealment (50%) on single target.
text: Grant subjects concealment (20% miss chance). If cast on a single subject, grants total concealment (50% miss chance). Defeated by true seeing / truth revealed, not see invisibility.

name: Life Fades
shortDescription: Touch deals 1d6/CL (max 5d6) nonlethal damage and fatigues (Fort negates fatigue).
text: Touch deals 1d6 nonlethal damage per caster level (max 5d6) and fatigues subject for 1 round/CL (Fortitude negates fatigue; does not stack to exhausted).

name: Flesh Fails

effects.text: Melee touch deals 4 Str, 4 Dex, or 2 Con ability damage (no save; SR applies).

shortDescription: Touch deals 4 Str, 4 Dex, or 2 Con damage (no save).
text: Touch deals either 4 points of Strength damage, 4 points of Dexterity damage, or 2 points of Constitution damage (choose at casting; no saving throw).

name: Umbral Touch
shortDescription: Melee touch deals 5d6 damage + Fort or slowed (1 attack/CL max).
text: Infuse one hand (occupies hand; threatens and allows AoOs). Melee touch deals 5d6 damage + Fort or slowed for 1 minute/CL (each hit reduces duration by 1 min; 1 hit/CL max).

name: Mesmerizing Shade

effects.condition: Dazed 1 round on failed Will save; -1 atk/checks/saves even on save

shortDescription: Target is dazed 1 round (Will save avoids daze, still -1 atk/checks/saves).
text: Flickering shadows daze the subject for 1 round; a successful Will save negates the daze, though the target still suffers a -1 penalty on attack rolls, checks, and saves.

name: Thoughts of Shadow

effects.condition: Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma at casting

shortDescription: Grant +4 enhancement bonus to Int, Wis, or Cha.
text: Grant the touched creature a +4 enhancement bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen at casting).

name: Afraid of the Dark
shortDescription: Twisted shadow reflection deals 1d6 + 1/4 CL (max +5) Wisdom damage (Will half).
text: Shadowy duplicate unerringly touches the foe, dealing 1d6 + 1/4 CL (max +5) Wisdom damage (Will save halves).

name: Warp Spell

delivery.target: A spell or mystery cast by someone else

effects.text: Immediate action counterspell via opposed CL check; on success, gain 1 extra Apprentice mystery use within 1 hour.

shortDescription: Immediate counterspell (opposed CL check) that grants extra Apprentice mystery use.
text: Immediate action at moment another casts: succeed on opposed CL check (1d20+CL vs enemy) to counter it and gain 1 extra use of a known Apprentice mystery within 1 hour.

name: Echo Spell

delivery.effect: Repeat a previously cast spell or mystery

effects.text: Duplicate an enemy's/ally's <=4th-level spell/mystery cast last round within range using your CL and Cha-based DC.

shortDescription: Recast a spell or mystery (<=4th level) cast within range last round under your control.
text: Echo a spell or mystery cast by someone else within range in the previous round (max 4th level and <= highest mystery level you can cast), using your CL and Cha modifier for DC.

name: Flood of Shadow

effects.text: Non-shadow casting needs Spellcraft DC 15+lvl; mysteries/shadow spells originating in area are automatically Empowered.

shortDescription: Non-shadow spells require Spellcraft DC 15+lvl; shadow spells/mysteries empowered.
text: In 20-ft. radius, casting non-shadow spells requires Spellcraft DC 15 + spell level or spell fails; mysteries and shadow-subschool spells originating inside are empowered (+50% variable numbers) at no level cost.

name: Bolster

effects.condition: 5 temporary HP per subject's Hit Die (max 75 temp HP)

shortDescription: Grant 5 temporary hit points per Hit Die (maximum 75).
text: Grant the touched creature 5 temporary hit points per Hit Die (maximum 75 temporary HP). Subject's shadow grows large and slightly uncoordinated (Spot DC 20).

name: Languor

delivery.target: One creature or 1/level within 30 ft.; see text

effects.text: Choose slow (1 creature/CL) or hold monster (single creature) upon casting.

shortDescription: Functions as either slow (multiple targets) or hold monster (single target).
text: Functions like slow (up to 1 creature/CL) or hold monster (single creature); choose mode when casting.

name: Shadow Investiture

effects.what: See in Darkness (even deeper darkness) + Evasion

shortDescription: Grants Cold Resistance 15, Evasion, and See in Darkness.
text: Infuse target with its own shadow: grants Cold Resistance 15, the evasion ability, and ability to see in magical darkness (including deeper darkness).

name: Shadow Evocation

effects.text: Mimics evocation spell <5th level (20% real).

shortDescription: Functions as shadow evocation (mimics <5th-level evocation, 20% real).
text: Functions like shadow evocation (PH 277), mimicking any evocation spell of lower than 5th level (20% real on disbelieve).

name: Feign Life

effects.text: Animates 1 Small object/CL as animate objects.

effects.what: Animated objects gain concealment (20% miss chance)

shortDescription: Functions as animate objects; animated objects also gain concealment (20%).
text: Functions like animate objects (PH 199), except animated objects appear warped and gain concealment (20% miss chance).

name: Shadow Evocation, Greater

effects.text: Mimics evocation spell <7th level (60% real).

shortDescription: Functions as greater shadow evocation (mimics <7th-level evocation, 60% real).
text: Functions like greater shadow evocation (PH 277), mimicking any evocation spell of lower than 7th level (60% real on disbelieve).

name: Step into Shadow

delivery.target: You and touched objects or willing creatures

effects.text: Long-range teleportation as dimension door.

shortDescription: Short-range shadow teleport functioning as dimension door.
text: Transport through the Plane of Shadow to any spot within Long range, functioning like dimension door.

name: Pass into Shadow

delivery.effect: Creature touched, or up to 8 willing creatures joining hands

effects.text: Plane shift with origin or destination on Plane of Shadow.

shortDescription: Functions as plane shift, except destination or origin must be Plane of Shadow.
text: Functions like plane shift, except either your destination or your point of origination must be the Plane of Shadow.

name: Voyage into Shadow

effects.text: Double shadow walk speed; DC 30 Knowledge (the planes) avoids arrival shunt.

shortDescription: Functions as shadow walk at double speed; DC 30 Kn.(planes) arrives at exact spot.
text: Functions like shadow walk, except movement speed on the Plane of Shadow is doubled (100 mph), and a DC 30 Knowledge (the planes) check lets you arrive exactly where desired.

name: Aura of Shade

effects.what: Cold absorption: 12 points per CL (max 120) + extreme temp immunity

effects.condition: Bonus damage on weapon/natural melee attacks while aura holds

shortDescription: Absorb 12 cold/CL (max 120) and melee attacks deal +1d6 cold damage.
text: Protects against extreme cold, absorbs up to 12 cold damage per CL (max 120, expiring when spent), and adds +1d6 cold damage to weapon/natural melee attacks while active.

name: Dark Air or Water

effects.text: Choose control winds or control water at casting.

shortDescription: Functions as control water or control winds (choose at casting).
text: Functions like control water or control winds (choose version at the time of casting).

name: Shadow Storm

effects.condition: Arcs to CL secondary targets (max 20) within 30 ft. for half damage

shortDescription: 1d6/CL (max 20d6) half electricity / half cold; arcs for half damage.
text: Blast of half electricity, half cold dealing 1d6/CL (max 20d6) to primary target, then arcs like chain lightning to 1/CL secondary targets (max 20) within 30 ft. for half damage.

name: Shadows Fade

delivery.target: One creature or object; or 20-ft.-radius burst

effects.text: Functions as dispel magic.

shortDescription: Functions as dispel magic.
text: Draw forth the shadow reflection of active magic to cancel it, functioning as dispel magic.

name: Unravel Dweomer

delivery.target: Up to 1 creature/level within 30 ft. of each other

effects.text: Functions as break enchantment.

shortDescription: Functions as break enchantment.
text: Leach out the energy maintaining ongoing magical effects, functioning like break enchantment.

name: Shadows Fade, Greater

delivery.target: One creature or object; or 20-ft.-radius burst

effects.text: Functions as greater dispel magic.

shortDescription: Functions as greater dispel magic.
text: More potent version of shadows fade functioning like greater dispel magic.

name: Shadow Vision

delivery.target: One creature with Int 3 or higher

effects.condition: Target also takes -4 on ability/skill checks (Will negates)

effects.what: Total concealment (50% miss chance) vs affected target

shortDescription: Target suffers -4 to attacks/saves/checks and treats you as having total concealment (50%).
text: Overlap target's vision with the Plane of Shadow: target takes -4 penalty on attack rolls, saves, ability checks, and skill checks, and you have total concealment (50% miss chance) against it.

name: Curtain of Shadows

delivery.effect: Shadowy wall up to one 10-ft. square/level (S)

effects.condition: Dealt to any creature passing through wall (no save)

shortDescription: Opaque wall of cold shadow deals 1d6/CL (max 15d6) cold to passers-through.
text: Wall of shadow completely blocks line of sight; any creature passing through takes 1d6 cold damage per caster level (maximum 15d6).

name: Unveil

effects.text: Removes 15 adverse conditions + shadow debuffs + curses as remove curse.

shortDescription: Cures ability damage, blinded, confused, dazed, dazzled, deafened, diseased, exhausted, fatigued, immobilized, insanity, nauseated, sickened, stunned, poisoned, curses.
text: Immediately ends ability damage, blinded, confused, dazed, dazzled, deafened, diseased, exhausted, fatigued, immobilized, insanity, nauseated, sickened, stunned, and poisoned; negates mesmerizing shade, shadow hood, and shadow between; cancels curses as remove curse.

name: Life Fades, Greater

delivery.target: One living creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius spread

effects.save: Fortitude half & reduces exhausted to fatigued

shortDescription: 1d6/CL (max 20d6) nonlethal damage + exhausted 1 rd/CL (Fort halves & reduces to fatigued).
text: Deals 1d6 nonlethal damage per CL (max 20d6) and causes exhaustion for 1 round/CL to up to 1 living creature/CL in 20-ft. spread (Fort halves damage and reduces exhaustion to fatigue).

name: Flesh Fails, Greater

delivery.target: One living creature/level in a 20-ft.-radius spread

effects.text: Deals 6 Str, 6 Dex, or 4 Con damage (same type for all) to 1 creature/CL in 20-ft. spread (no save; SR applies).

shortDescription: Deals 6 Str, 6 Dex, or 4 Con damage to 1 creature/CL in 20-ft. spread (no save).
text: As flesh fails, affecting up to 1 living creature/CL in a 20-ft. spread and dealing 6 Str, 6 Dex, or 4 Con damage to all targets (no save).

name: Ephemeral Storm

delivery.target: 1 living creature/2 levels (no two >20 ft. apart)

effects.save: Fortitude partial (die on fail, 5d6 on save)

shortDescription: Shadow blades force Fortitude save or die (5d6 damage on success).
text: Up to 1 living creature per 2 levels (within 20 ft. of each other) must succeed on a Fortitude save or die; those succeeding still take 5d6 damage.

name: Ephemeral Image

effects.text: As project image; duplicate also has concealment outside sunlight/daylight.

effects.what: Image has concealment (20%) unless in sunlight/daylight

shortDescription: Functions as project image; duplicate also has concealment (20%) outside bright sunlight/daylight.
text: Functions like project image, except the shadow duplicate benefits from concealment (20% miss chance) unless in direct sunlight or a daylight spell.

name: Umbral Body
shortDescription: Gain the incorporeal subtype and all associated traits.
text: Become a being of shadow, gaining the incorporeal subtype (deflection AC = Cha mod min +1, immune to nonmagical attacks, 50% miss vs magic non-force, pass through solids, etc.).

name: Shadow Time

effects.text: Functions as time stop for 1d4+4 rounds of apparent time.

shortDescription: Functions as time stop, except duration is 1d4+4 apparent rounds.
text: Functions like the time stop spell, except you gain 1d4+4 rounds of apparent time.

name: Prison of Night

effects.condition: Dealt at start of each round inside prison
Dealt when target fails standard-action escape save

shortDescription: Impenetrable shadow prison deals 1d6 cold/round + 1d4 Con on failed escape Fort save.
text: Immobilizes target inside impenetrable prison blocking line of sight/effect; deals 1d6 cold/round. Target may spend standard action each turn for Fort save to escape or take 1d4 Con damage.

name: Tomb of Night

effects.condition: Dealt at start of each round inside tomb

effects.text: Target gains 1 negative level whenever it fails its standard-action Fortitude save to break free.

shortDescription: As prison of night, but deals 3d6 cold/round and 1 negative level on failed escape.
text: Functions like prison of night, except trapped target takes 3d6 cold damage per round and gains 1 negative level (instead of Con damage) on a failed escape save.

name: Consume Essence

effects.text: Death effect: Will negates; if slain, reanimates with dark creature template under your control for 1 round/level.

shortDescription: Slay creature (Will negates) and reanimate as controlled dark creature for 1 rd/CL.
text: Target must succeed on a Will save or die. If slain, it immediately returns to life with the dark creature template under your control for 1 round/level before dying again.

name: Truth Revealed

effects.text: Immediate true seeing; 1-3 rounds concentration unlocks detect alignment/magic/thoughts, discern lies, fear/love/name, recent actions.

shortDescription: Functions as true seeing, plus concentration reveals alignments/thoughts/lies/past.
text: Grants true seeing immediately. Concentrating 1–3 rounds on a creature/object can replicate detect evil/good/law/chaos/magic/thoughts, discern lies (1 rd), greatest fear/love/name (2 rds), or recent actions (3 rds) — extra info may be misleading.

name: Far Sight

effects.text: As greater scrying combined with truth revealed.

shortDescription: Functions as greater scrying combined with truth revealed.
text: Functions like greater scrying, and also grants the true seeing and additional study benefits of truth revealed through the sensor.

name: Reflections of Things to Come

effects.text: Uncanny Dodge; discharge (immediate action) to negate a successful hit or reroll one failed saving throw.

shortDescription: Uncanny Dodge, +10 insight Initiative, +4 insight AC; discharge to dodge attack or reroll save.
text: Grants Uncanny Dodge, +10 insight to Initiative (always act in surprise round), and +4 insight bonus to AC. Discharge as immediate action to make a successful hit miss or reroll one failed save.

name: Dark Soul

effects.text: Standard action: living creature within 30 ft. must make Will save (DC 17 + Cha mod) or immediately melee attack an adjacent target.

shortDescription: Standard action compels living creature within 30 ft. to immediately make a melee attack.
text: While active, spend a standard action to force one living creature within 30 ft. to succeed on a Will save (DC 17 + Cha mod) or immediately make a melee attack against a target within its reach.

name: Soul Puppet

effects.text: Functions as dominate monster (range Touch, duration 1 day/level).

shortDescription: Functions as dominate monster (1 day/level, touch).
text: Control a living creature's body via shadow tendrils, following the mechanics of dominate monster (true seeing/truth revealed spots the tendrils).

name: Shadow Surge

delivery.target: Up to 1 living creature/level within 30 ft. of each other

effects.text: Mass dominate monster affecting 1 creature/CL for 1 round.

shortDescription: Functions as dominate monster affecting 1 living creature/level for 1 round.
text: Functions like dominate monster, except it affects up to one living creature per caster level (all within 30 ft. of each other) for 1 round.

name: Summon Umbral Servant

effects.text: Summon 1 Huge, 2 Large, or 4 Medium/smaller shadow elementals.

shortDescription: Summon 1 Huge, 2 Large, or 4 Medium/smaller shadow elementals.
text: Functions like summon monster I, except you summon 1 Huge, 2 Large, or 4 Medium/smaller shadow elementals.

name: Shadow Plague

delivery.effect: Cloud spreads in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high

shortDescription: Functions as incendiary cloud, except dealing 4d6 cold damage per round.
text: Functions like the spell incendiary cloud (4d6 damage/round in 20-ft.-radius cloud), except it deals cold damage rather than fire damage.

name: Army of Shadow

delivery.effect: One or more summoned shadow elementals

effects.text: Summon 1 Elder, 2 Greater, 4 Huge, or 8 Large shadow elementals for 1 min/level.

shortDescription: Summon 1 Elder, 2 Greater, 4 Huge, or 8 Large shadow elementals.
text: Functions like summon monster I, except duration is 1 min/level and you summon 1 elder, 2 greater, 4 Huge, or 8 Large shadow elementals.
